comment: Approved new-rule numbers as validated data (framework contract sections: Mana and Stamina, Weight Class and Dodge Roll, Unarmed fallback, Deck composition). No formula constant lives in code.

weight.capacityBaseNote: Was 50, then 5. Validated by tools/weightclass-census.mjs (2026-09-01), which measures every creatable start (each hand chosen independently, empty allowed) and, for reachability, every ordered pair of DISTINCT armaments through a real loadout. Base 50 left even the heaviest reachable kit at 34-40% (Light): no loadout could leave Light and the class did not exist for the player. Base 5 (the first retune) still left three of four classes unable to reach Heavy at tuned attributes (Reaver 77%, Starseer 78%, Rogue 69%; only Herald 81%) once the double-tower-shield error in the first census was removed. At 0 — capacity is exactly 2*CON + STR — every class can reach Heavy (Reaver 88%, Starseer 92%, Rogue 80%, Herald 96% with warhammer + tower shield + heaviest outfit) and 290 of 336 creatable starts are Light, 46 Medium, none Heavy.
